candidates.title: Waterloo Bridge, Sunlight Effect
candidates.credit: Claude Monet (French, 1840–1926) / Art Institute of Chicago
candidates.alt_suggestion: Horizontal oil painting in shades of pale purple, pink, and light blue of a bridge composed of multiple linked archways over water, engulfed in hazy fog. Various indistinct, colorful forms cross the bridge, and factory smokestacks rise in the distance.

candidates.title: Dunning-Kruger effekten.png
candidates.alt_suggestion: En kognitiv bias som innebär att den som är inkompetent också är oförmögen att förstå att denne är inkompetent

candidates.title: Stacks of Wheat (Sunset, Snow Effect)
candidates.credit: Claude Monet (French, 1840–1926) / Art Institute of Chicago
candidates.alt_suggestion: Two haystacks, dusted with snow, in a hazy, snow-covered field at sunset. The snow is highlighted in purple tones, the sky a yellow and orange gradient.
